listing.name: Escape from Monster Manor — pc-escapefrommonstermanor (vs-sr-dev)
listing.summary: Experimental project. The project reports the first Attic Simple level and reference frames. Monsters run at twice the FZ10 pace until cel-processing cost is modelled. Completion of all 12 levels has not been confirmed. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own European 3DO Escape from Monster Manor disc in MODE1/2352 format with 230700 sectors and Portfolio21.10 files. Keep your original game files separately. The recorded source review did not download or run the game.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract your own disc, generate the static ARM code and build with CMake. Start pfboot --boot --window. Portcove does not manage this download and has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

warnings: The project reports the first Attic Simple level and reference frames. Monsters run at twice the FZ10 pace until cel-processing cost is modelled. Completion of all 12 levels has not been confirmed. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
